policy: Buscar repos actuales por estrellas, actividad reciente y licencia. Usarlos como referencia revisable, no como copia literal de marca, assets, claims o identidad visual.
selectionRules: Priorizar repos con alta adopcion, pushes recientes y licencias claras MIT o Apache-2.0.
Usar NOASSERTION o repos de marca propietaria solo como lectura de patrones, nunca como codigo copiado.
Antes de reutilizar codigo, retokenizar estilos, revisar accesibilidad, adaptar al rubro y pasar QA responsive.
Para webs de clientes, cruzar estos repos con referencias exactas del rubro y assets aprobados por el cliente.

skillSources.description: AI skill for professional UI/UX across multiple platforms.
skillSources.usage: Primary external skill reference for design reasoning, anti-generic decisions, UI style variety and high-level design rules.
skillSources.risk: Do not blindly copy rules or generated outputs. Extract principles, compare against ONIA brand rules, and keep client assets/licensing separate.

skillSources.description: Collection of DESIGN.md analyses by popular developer-focused websites.
skillSources.usage: Use as a pattern library for design specs that agents can follow before generating client websites.
skillSources.risk: Treat brand examples as reference analysis only. Never copy brand identity or exact composition.

skillSources.description: Animated, interactive and customizable React components for memorable websites.
skillSources.usage: Use for motion pattern inspiration and component behavior studies for premium landing pages.
skillSources.risk: License requires manual review before copying code. Prefer extracting interaction ideas and reimplementing inside ONIA patterns.

skillSources.usage: Use to discover non-obvious design systems by industry and maturity.
skillSources.risk: Index only. Follow each linked system's own license and brand rules.

skillSources.description: Production-ready UI blocks, components and full pages for shadcn/ui and Base UI with Framer Motion.
skillSources.usage: Use as a block-level inspiration source for landing builders, background builders and motion-ready sections.
skillSources.risk: Retokenize and rebuild. Do not ship default block styling.

skillSources.description: Ready-to-use DESIGN.md inspirations for agent-generated UI scaffolds.
skillSources.usage: Use as secondary DESIGN.md source when Web Factory needs fast style directions for a new vertical.
skillSources.risk: Avoid turning DESIGN.md files into copied brand templates.

skillSources.description: Bookmarks, resources and articles for product designers.
skillSources.usage: Use for UX process, product thinking, research and decision quality rather than component code.
skillSources.risk: Not a current UI component source. Use for product framing.

skillSources.usage: Use as broad discovery index only when direct sources are not enough.
skillSources.risk: Less current than other sources and license unclear. Do not copy content from linked resources without review.

skillSources.description: Frontend design skill with commands for UI design, critique, polish and iteration.
skillSources.usage: Public repo is low-adoption; use the installed local `.agents/skills/impeccable` as the authoritative ONIA source.
skillSources.risk: Do not rank as popular. Keep as evidence that public mirrors exist, not as primary external benchmark.

repos.description: Popular HTML, CSS and JavaScript framework for responsive projects.
repos.usage: Usar como baseline de responsive, layout, navegacion y componentes probados cuando el cliente necesita una web simple y robusta.
repos.risk: Puede producir resultados genericos si se copia el look; usar solo patrones y adaptar visualmente.

repos.description: Accessible components and code distribution platform for modern frameworks.
repos.usage: Referencia principal para componentes React/Tailwind sobrios, accesibles y faciles de adaptar a ONIA Center o landings premium.
repos.risk: No copiar temas por defecto; retokenizar spacing, color, copy y estados.

repos.description: React component library implementing Material Design.
repos.usage: Usar como referencia de sistemas complejos, formularios, tablas y estados de componentes para dashboards o SaaS.
repos.risk: Puede sentirse corporativo generico si no se personaliza la marca.

repos.description: Enterprise-class UI design language and React UI library.
repos.usage: Referencia para productos operativos densos: formularios, tablas, filtros, dashboards y permisos.
repos.risk: Evitar copiar estetica enterprise por defecto en webs comerciales pequenas.

repos.description: Utility-first CSS framework for rapid UI development.
repos.usage: Referencia base para sistemas de tokens, responsive rapido y componentes propios de Web Factory.
repos.risk: Sin direccion visual, Tailwind acelera lo generico; exigir referencias y criterio por rubro.

repos.usage: Usar para acelerar prototipos, estados y componentes de baja friccion cuando el presupuesto exige velocidad.
repos.risk: Controlar tema para que no parezca plantilla.

repos.description: Component system for building SaaS products.
repos.usage: Referencia para accesibilidad, theming y componentes SaaS mantenibles.
repos.risk: No mezclar con Tailwind sin decidir arquitectura visual.

repos.description: Modern animation library for React and JavaScript.
repos.usage: Referencia principal para animaciones sobrias: entradas, microinteracciones, reveal y motion con performance controlada.
repos.risk: No animar hero/video si degrada performance; preferir transform/opacity y reduced motion.

repos.usage: Referencia para formularios, inputs complejos y dashboards con buen equilibrio entre velocidad y calidad.
repos.risk: Revisar bundle y consistencia visual si se usa con Next/Tailwind.

repos.description: Modern React UI library, previously NextUI.
repos.usage: Referencia para componentes modernos visualmente fuertes cuando el rubro permite una UI mas expresiva.
repos.risk: Controlar exceso de efectos y contraste; adaptar a marca del cliente.

repos.description: UI library for design engineers with animated components and effects.
repos.usage: Referencia para motion y secciones memorables; usar con moderacion en heroes, social proof y producto.
repos.risk: Puede verse de moda pero no vender; exigir que cada efecto ayude conversion o claridad.

repos.description: Utilities, React components and web components for applications.
repos.usage: Solo como lectura de patrones enterprise y accesibilidad; no copiar codigo sin revisar licencia real por paquete.
repos.risk: NOASSERTION exige revision manual antes de cualquier reutilizacion.

repos.description: Accessible primitives for high-quality design systems and web apps.
repos.usage: Referencia fuerte para accesibilidad y comportamiento de componentes headless.
repos.risk: Necesita capa visual propia; no resuelve direccion creativa por si solo.

repos.usage: Referencia para productos B2B tecnicos, tablas, estados y documentacion de sistema.
repos.risk: Evitar look IBM/corporativo si el cliente necesita cercania comercial.

repos.description: Open-source component library optimized for development and accessibility.
repos.usage: Referencia para theming simple sobre primitives, especialmente si ONIA necesita consistencia rapida.
repos.risk: Menor actividad reciente que otros; revisar antes de adoptar.

repos.description: GitHub Primer Design System implementation using React.
repos.usage: Referencia para claridad, estados de herramientas, docs, settings y flujos developer/producto.
repos.risk: No copiar identidad GitHub ni patrones demasiado reconocibles.

repos.description: React components built for Flowbite and Tailwind CSS.
repos.usage: Referencia secundaria para patrones Tailwind y componentes comunes cuando no haya mejor fit.
repos.risk: Menor actividad reciente; revisar vigencia antes de usar.
